name: 知識管理與學校發展 - 課程教案網站
message: Website built successfully with all lesson plan content in Chinese (zh). Includes: lesson page with 9 sections (ILOs, pre-class prep, teaching activities, assessment, alignment matrix, resources, differentiation, quality control, materials), 10-slide presentation with fullscreen/keyboard navigation, diagnostic quiz (8 questions), discussion forums, concept checks, teacher dashboard with student progress/quiz results, login system with teacher/student roles, and editable content for teachers. Build passes TypeScript checking.
